title: LAHM : Large Annotated Dataset for Multi-Domain and Multilingual Hate Speech Identification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-class hate speech detection models (e.g., mBERT, DistilBERT) in cross-lingual and translated settings on a newly curated multilingual dataset to classify text in the 'Racism' domain using precision, recall, and F1-score.
